description: Adversarially stress-tests a feature's SPEC.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and PLAN.md before feature-build starts: independent review lenses in parallel, each finding refuted by a skeptic to kill noise, survivors triaged with the user one by one. Optional and heavyweight — reach for it on a large or risky plan, not every one. Use when asked to interrogate, pressure-test, stress-test, or find the gaps in a plan, or before committing to a risky build.
